description: Get stored end-of-day OHLCV candles for a stock, ETF, or crypto ticker, daily or weekly. Use this for exact-return calculations, charts, and backtests after get_summary identifies a setup. Results are paginated; pass next_cursor back as cursor to continue. Prices are stored as traded; adjustment picks the basis: split (default), split_dividend (total return) or raw. Credit cost is 1 credit per 100 bars returned, rounded up, with a 1 credit minimum.

adjustment.description: Price basis. split (default): today's share basis, every split applied. split_dividend: splits plus cash dividends (a total-return series). raw: as traded on each date (daily only for ohlcv).

cursor.description: Exclusive date cursor from next_cursor for pagination (YYYY-MM-DD).

end.description: Inclusive end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Compared against the candle date.

order.description: Sort by candle date. Default: desc.

start.description: Inclusive start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Compared against the candle date, so for weekly this is the Sunday week end. Lookback is limited by plan.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, BTCUSD, SPY

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe. Default: daily. Weekly candles cover Monday-Sunday and are dated by the Sunday week end, matching get_summary with timeframe=weekly. The in-progress week is not returned.

name: get_ohlcv

data.description: The TickerDB API response payload for this tool call.
